products.name: Microsoft Teams Phone Direct Routing with Session Border Controller (AudioCodes) Integration — Commercial
products.short_description: Deliver PSTN calling in Microsoft Teams Phone via Direct Routing with an AudioCodes Session Border Controller — pair the SBC, build the Teams voice routing stack (PSTN gateway, voice routes, PSTN usages, voice routing policies, dial plans), enable users, and validate inbound/outbound and emergency calling. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Pair the SBC, route the calls, and pick up the phone in Teams

Bringing PSTN calling into Microsoft Teams Phone with Direct Routing and a Session Border Controller is precise work — get the SBC pairing, certificates, SIP signaling, or the voice-routing chain wrong and you get an Inactive SBC, one-way audio, or failed emergency calls. This solution is the exact runbook: pair the AudioCodes SBC to Teams (New-CsOnlinePSTNGateway), build the named voice-routing stack (PSTN usages, voice routes, voice routing policy, dial plan), enable users with Phone System + numbers, and validate inbound, outbound, caller ID, and emergency calling. The Teams side is concrete (admin center + Teams PowerShell); AudioCodes device-specific configuration is documented as a checklist and deferred to AudioCodes' docs.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Direct Routing + SBC architecture and the Teams voice-routing chain.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Teams Phone licensing, an AudioCodes SBC with public FQDN + CA cert, verified SIP domain, carrier/PSTN, Teams PowerShell, firewall for SIP TLS 5061 + SRTP media, emergency-calling plan, pilot users) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps + cmdlets: pair the SBC, build PSTN usages/voice routes/voice routing policy/dial plan (named objects), enable pilot users, with the AudioCodes-side checklist deferred to vendor docs.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts (MicrosoftTeams module) — voice-config discovery, validation (gateway health + routing chain + user assignment), config/assignment report, safe re-grant/assign remediation, and a one-shot voice-routing builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (SBC Active/SIP OPTIONS healthy, outbound connects, inbound DID routes, caller ID, emergency calling), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An AudioCodes SBC paired to Teams Phone via Direct Routing with a clean, named voice-routing stack and enabled users — inbound, outbound, caller ID, and emergency calling all validated — delivered by your own team.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TEAMSSBC-Discovery.ps1 — TEAMSSBC-Discovery — Read the current Microsoft Teams Phone Direct Routing
    • TEAMSSBC-Remediation.ps1 — TEAMSSBC-Remediation — Apply safe, targeted fixes to a single named user's
    • TEAMSSBC-Report.ps1 — TEAMSSBC-Report — Export the Microsoft Teams Phone Direct Routing voice
    • TEAMSSBC-Set-VoiceRouting.ps1 — TEAMSSBC-Set-VoiceRouting — Create the Microsoft Teams Phone Direct Routing
    • TEAMSSBC-Validation.ps1 — TEAMSSBC-Validation — Verify a Microsoft Teams Phone Direct Routing build is

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
